name: Google Search via SerpApi
description: Run a Google search and get structured SERP results including organic results, local pack, knowledge graph, and related questions. Supports location targeting, language, pagination, and device emulation.

query.description: Search query (supports Google operators like site:, inurl:, intitle:)

location.description: Location to search from (e.g., 'Austin, Texas, United States')

start.description: Result offset for pagination (0 = first page, 10 = second page)
